message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and drops columns but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, null checks, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths only; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any file.

No detected label flipping detection: The code maps text labels to IDs via a reverse dictionary but never validates that label values fall within the expected set or checks for label distribution anomalies before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to the training, dev, or test datasets at any point in the preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained embeddings via `load_embedding()` and constructs the RNNClassifier from scratch without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity of loaded weights or serialized models.

No detected label distribution validation: The code computes class weights for loss balancing but does not explicitly validate or assert anything about the label distribution or expected label set before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, neural cleanse, or any other backdoor/trigger detection mechanism in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are present anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although separate train/dev/test splits are loaded, there is no hashing, signing, or isolation mechanism to protect against metric manipulation; the test set is constructed using the training dictionary and there are no integrity checks on evaluation data.
No detected input sanitization: The inference/evaluation path in evaluate.py directly passes batch data to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: After torch.max is applied to model outputs, there are no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validations before results are used.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an RNN-based text classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
